user.title: Set up PostNord
user.description: How do you want to follow your PostNord parcels?

tracking.title: Set up PostNord tracking codes
tracking.description: Add PostNord parcel tracking. No account or API key is needed. After setup, add parcels via the integration options or the `postnord.track_parcel` service.

account.title: Log in to your PostNord account
account.description:
Open this link in a browser and log in with your PostNord account: {authorize_url}

PostNord finishes the login by sending your browser to a `com.postnord.app://redirect…` address, which the browser cannot open — that is expected. Open your browser's developer tools on the Network tab and turn on **Preserve log** before you log in, then copy that address from the request list or from the **Location** header of the last `account.postnord.com` request — see [step-by-step instructions]({docs_url}). Paste it below within a few minutes: the code in it works only once.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to PostNord again
reauth_confirm.description: PostNord no longer accepts the stored login for {email}. Open this link, log in with that account and paste the redirect URL you catch in your browser's developer tools (see [step-by-step instructions]({docs_url})): {authorize_url}

error.invalid_redirect: That is not the redirect URL of this login, or its code has expired. Copy the full `com.postnord.app://redirect?code=…` address and paste it within a few minutes; if it keeps failing, log in again with the same link.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach PostNord's login service.

abort.already_configured: This PostNord account or tracking hub is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That login is for a different PostNord account. Log in with the account this entry was set up for.

error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.
